accepted.sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.label,d.bucket FROM (SELECT reverse(label) AS label,COALESCE(abs(cohort),0)+2 AS bucket FROM {schema}.account) d WHERE d.bucket>=3
SELECT a.cohort AS g,COUNT(*) AS n,SUM(abs(b.amount)) AS total,AVG(abs(b.amount)) AS mean FROM {schema}.account a JOIN {schema}.entry b ON abs(a.cohort)=abs(b.account_id) GROUP BY a.cohort

SELECT a.cohort AS g,COUNT(*) AS n,COUNT(b.amount) AS present,SUM(b.amount) AS total FROM {schema}.account a LEFT JOIN {schema}.entry b ON a.cohort+2=b.account_id+2 WHERE b.amount IS NULL OR b.amount>=0 GROUP BY a.cohort
SELECT a.cohort AS g,COUNT(*) AS n FROM {schema}.account a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {schema}.entry b WHERE a.cohort+2=b.account_id+2) GROUP BY a.cohort
SELECT d.g,COUNT(*) AS n,MAX(d.v) AS v FROM (SELECT account_id AS g,AVG(amount) AS v FROM {schema}.entry GROUP BY account_id) d WHERE d.v>=0 GROUP BY d.g
SELECT d.g,SUM(d.v) OVER(ORDER BY d.g ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS v FROM (SELECT account_id AS g,AVG(amount) AS v FROM {schema}.entry GROUP BY account_id) d
SELECT d.id,COALESCE(d.v,0::numeric)+2 AS v FROM (SELECT id,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS v FROM {schema}.entry) d WHERE d.v>=0
SELECT a.cohort AS g,COUNT(*) AS n,SUM(abs(b.amount)+2) AS total FROM {schema}.account a JOIN {schema}.entry b ON abs(a.cohort)=abs(b.account_id) JOIN {schema}.region r ON a.id=r.id GROUP BY a.cohort
